title: Contract Q&A assistant for a legal-tech startup
problem: Paralegals spent hours searching 40k contracts for indemnity and termination clauses.
approach: Built a retrieval pipeline with clause-aware chunking, hybrid search and citations, served behind an API.
result: Cut clause lookup from ~25 minutes to under 1 minute; 92% of answers cited the correct clause in a 200-question audit.

title: Multi-step support agent with tool calls
problem: Tier-1 support tickets piled up overnight.
approach: Designed a stateful agent that classifies tickets, looks up orders and drafts replies for human approval.
result: Auto-drafted 61% of tickets; agents accepted 78% of drafts with minor edits.

title: Retail demand forecasting
problem: Store managers over-ordered perishables before holidays.
approach: Combined a seasonal forecaster with a gradient-boosted residual model, refreshed nightly.
result: MAPE dropped from 31% to 14% across 120 SKUs; waste fell ~18% in the pilot stores.

title: Invoice data extraction pipeline
problem: An accounts team keyed in 3,000 scanned invoices a month by hand.
approach: OCR with image deskewing, then entity extraction for vendor, totals, dates and tax IDs.
result: Field-level accuracy 96% on a held-out set of 500 invoices; manual entry time down 70%.

title: Defect detection on a packaging line
problem: Mislabelled boxes reached customers despite manual checks.
approach: Trained a real-time detector on 6k annotated frames and deployed it on an edge box next to the conveyor.
result: Recall 0.94 / precision 0.91 on defects at 28 FPS; customer complaints about labels fell by half.

title: Brand-voice copy model
problem: Copywriters rewrote generic LLM drafts to match each client's tone.
approach: Fine-tuned a 7B open model with adapters per brand and built a blind tone-match evaluation.
result: Editors preferred the tuned model's drafts 71% of the time in a blind test of 300 pairs.

title: Semantic product search
problem: Customers searching 'something to keep coffee hot' found nothing.
approach: Embedded 80k products with a sentence-transformer and served vector search with keyword fallback.
result: Search-to-cart conversion up 11% in an A/B test; zero-result searches down 64%.

title: Churn prediction for a telecom
problem: Retention offers were sent to everyone, wasting budget.
approach: Built a calibrated churn classifier with SHAP explanations and tracked experiments.
result: AUC 0.87; targeting the top decile saved ~$40k per quarter in offer costs.

title: Medical-notes de-identification
problem: Researchers could not use clinical notes until PHI was removed.
approach: Combined rule patterns with a fine-tuned NER model to redact names, dates and IDs.
result: PHI recall 0.98 on 1,000 annotated notes, audited by the clinic's privacy officer.

title: Model monitoring and retraining service
problem: A credit model silently degraded for months.
approach: Set up drift detection, scheduled retraining and a model registry with approval gates.
result: Drift is caught within 24h; retraining went from a 2-week manual task to a 40-minute pipeline.

title: Research-paper RAG over arXiv
problem: Students struggled to find relevant prior work quickly.
approach: Open-source tool with section-aware chunking, reranking and answer-faithfulness checks.
result: 340 GitHub stars; faithfulness 0.89 on a 150-question benchmark I released.

title: Real-time call-centre sentiment
problem: Supervisors only learned about angry callers after the call ended.
approach: Streaming transcription chunks scored for sentiment and pushed to a live supervisor view.
result: Median alert latency 1.8 s; escalations resolved 22% faster.

title: Resume-to-job matching engine
problem: Recruiters manually screened hundreds of CVs per role.
approach: Structured extraction of CVs into skills and experience, then hybrid ranking with explanations.
result: Recruiter shortlist agreement 0.81 (Cohen's kappa 0.62) on 50 roles.

title: Image classification for crop disease
problem: Farmers had no quick way to identify leaf diseases.
approach: Transfer-learned a small CNN and shipped it as an offline-capable API for a mobile app.
result: Top-1 accuracy 93% across 12 diseases; used by ~2,000 farmers in the pilot.

title: Async document processing backend
problem: Uploading a 300-page contract timed out the web app.
approach: Moved parsing and embedding into a queue of background workers with retries and progress events.
result: Upload timeouts went to zero; throughput 1,200 pages/minute on two workers.

title: LLM guardrails and red-teaming
problem: A customer-facing bot could be tricked into revealing internal notes.
approach: Built an injection test suite (180 attacks), delimiting and output filters, and a regression gate in CI.
result: Attack success fell from 34% to 3% on the suite; no regressions in answer quality.
